items.title: Transiently deflated Antimatter.totalSupply() between the burn (:239) and the phUSD mint (:260)
items.detail: Between :239 and :260 the AM supply has fallen while the offsetting phUSD has not yet been created. Untrusted code executes inside that window: the `stable` token (safeTransferFrom :246, forceApprove :247/:253) and the registered yield strategy (via PhusdStableMinter.sol:229).
items.impactIfItHolds: Any future contract reading Antimatter.totalSupply() or balanceOf as a valuation input - a backing-ratio oracle, an AM/phUSD TWAP, a collateral valuer - becomes directly manipulable from that window.
items.action: Re-check on any commit that introduces an on-chain consumer of Antimatter.totalSupply() or Antimatter.balanceOf.
items.doNotCollapseWith: run-01 parked MR-01 (phUSD.totalSupply transient inconsistency) - different token, different direction (deflated vs under-counted), different consumer.

items.title: Orphaned AM approvals and a breaking interface removal after annihilateFrom was deleted
items.detail: c91bc1a deleted _spendAllowance and replaced annihilateFrom(stable,from,recipient,amount) with annihilate(stable,recipient,amount). Verified: grep for _spendAllowance over src/ returns zero hits. NO PRIVILEGE ESCALATION EXISTS - annihilateFrom never constrained the allowance it spent, so any approval sufficient to drive it was always equally sufficient for a bare transferFrom; the removal STRICTLY REDUCES what an outstanding approval can accomplish.
items.residual: (a) any integrator built against the old signature is broken; (b) holders retain AM approvals granted for a purpose that no longer exists. No DB pattern covers breaking-interface removal, so without this park the item falls into the negative space entirely.
items.action: Confirm deployment/integrator status. If Antimatter is undeployed, close as no-impact. If deployed with integrators, treat as a migration and communication item, not a vulnerability.

items.title: The decimals cross-check protects the Antimatter path only; PhusdStableMinter.mint remains permissionless and still scales by the unverified registered decimals
items.detail: story-002 closes ledger M-01 (a1c81428a47ad295) at Antimatter's entry point - every annihilate routes through toStableAmount at :230 and a registered/actual decimals disagreement reverts in BOTH directions (Tier-3 INV6 PASS: 52 understated and 50 overstated attempts, 0 settled). But the mis-scaling root cause is PhusdStableMinter.calculateMintAmount's `10 ** (18 - config.decimals)`, reached directly by the minter's own PERMISSIONLESS mint(address,uint256) at PhusdStableMinter.sol:203. Anyone can call that path without touching Antimatter and still mint phUSD against a mis-registered decimals figure. Antimatter cannot fix this from its side; its own fix is correct for what it controls.
items.criticalWarning: M-01 is fix-pending. Any future proposal to mark it FIXED must state that the closure is BOUNDARY-SCOPED - correct for Antimatter, silent for every direct minter caller. Closing M-01 without that qualification would bury a live permissionless mis-scaling path.
items.recommendation: Move the cross-check into PhusdStableMinter.registerStablecoin so the invariant is established once, at registration, for every consumer.
items.action: Owner decision: accept the boundary-scoped closure, or raise the fix upstream in phUSD-stable-minter.
